reason: v1 improved all safety metrics but its jointly optimized blend stayed near 1.0. A development-only scan showed strong degradation-dependent blend variation, so v2 learns the blend target directly from training pairs before fitting the spatial residual.

scientific_boundary.c009: Immutable completed negative confirmatory evidence; no C009 file or verdict is replaced.
scientific_boundary.development_data: The former C009 D0 synthetic holdout is reused as an explicitly unblinded C010 development set.
scientific_boundary.confirmation: Any selected MERIT v2 design requires a newly acquired or never-used confirmatory test set. C009 endpoints cannot confirm v2.
scientific_boundary.claim: This pilot can establish engineering feasibility only.

base.policy: Frozen; always called with zero prompt channels.

training.source: C006 D0 rows labelled train only

blend_calibration.target: Per-sample least-squares alpha for degraded + alpha*(base-degraded), clipped to [0.5,1.5]

residual_fit.loss: L1 + gradient L1 + 0.1*FFT with calibrated blend frozen; no detector/task loss

training.checkpoint_selection: Fixed final stage outputs for this protocol version

development_evaluation.unit: Mean within physical parent before paired bootstrap
development_evaluation.primary_target: Mean v2-minus-base PSNR >= 0.10 dB and parent-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
development_evaluation.identity_target: Zero-prompt mean and p99 absolute output change <= 1e-7
